selection: 12 recent Khaos maintenance and test-reliability fixes/features from the public repository history, stratified across protocol, scope, compatibility, refactor, Runner, race, cleanup, and test-harness work; selection is fixed before model runs.
scope_limitations: This is a Khaos-specific sample, not a representative cross-project SWE-bench score.
The historical source commits and task text are public; model pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out.
Model task workspaces contain one frozen root commit only; no future commit objects or hidden grading patches are copied into them.
Tasks 10-12 measure test and harness repair, and task 9 targets a test fixture; these results are reported separately from production-code fix rate.

tasks.title: Bound IPC JSON nesting consistently
tasks.prompt: The IPC JSON decoder behaves differently for deeply nested input on supported Python versions. Make over-depth frames fail consistently through the existing bounded protocol error path, preserve normal frames and the error envelope, and add focused regression coverage. Do not widen protocol limits.

tasks.title: Honor the selected Plugin package grant
tasks.prompt: The signed Launcher selects a Plugin package through the system Picker, but package reads must remain within the exact security-scoped grant returned by that choice. Fix the handoff so the selected package can be read and the grant is released on every exit path; do not broaden package access.

tasks.title: Restore local generation on macOS 26
tasks.prompt: The AgentHost no longer compiles against the macOS 26 FoundationModels GenerationOptions API. Restore the local generation path while keeping greedy sampling and the existing response-token limits for both Agent actions and Candidate output. Do not add a provider fallback or change the sandbox.

tasks.title: Remove the duplicate direct APFS backend
tasks.prompt: The signed Kernel Python bundle still contains a direct APFS image backend even though image ownership is enforced through the authenticated Broker lease. Remove that duplicate backend while preserving the Broker checks and fail-closed behavior. Keep the change focused and update the relevant contract and build checks.

tasks.title: Add bounded Runner failure diagnostics
tasks.prompt: A Worker-launched Runner can fail before its startup handshake, but the failure stage is currently lost. Add a bounded internal diagnostic with a closed stage/category, child exit status, and elapsed time. At most 4 KiB of pre-Plugin stderr may be read and it must be reduced to a closed category and discarded; keep the public error generic and preserve the standalone Runner behavior. Update tests and ABI documentation.

tasks.title: Classify bounded Runner startup failures
tasks.prompt: Runner startup can fail during the sandbox probe, process spawn, peer identity check, or pipe handshake. Preserve the generic public failure while recording only a bounded, closed internal stage/category and child status. Keep timeouts, peer checks, scope, and fail-closed behavior intact; add focused tests.

tasks.title: Distinguish OS and Python startup exceptions
tasks.prompt: The bounded Runner startup classifier sometimes labels Python exceptions as operating-system failures. Classify only known OS exception classes as runner_os_error; RuntimeError, TypeError, and ValueError must remain runner_startup_exception. Keep raw stderr private and discarded, and add focused regression tests.

tasks.title: Keep the peer socket through both PID checks
tasks.prompt: The Runner startup parent closes its AF_UNIX connection after checking the child PID. If the child is scheduled later, its LOCAL_PEERPID query can fail with ENOTCONN before the first ping. Keep the connection alive until the child validates the parent PID and acknowledges completion under the existing deadline. Preserve PID/nonce checks, sandbox policy, and fail-closed behavior.

tasks.title: Reconcile nested image cleanup in the mount probe
tasks.prompt: The mount attack fixture can see an empty device inventory briefly while its inner image still owns the outer work volume. It then raises and masks the primary fixture failure during outer cleanup. Make the fixture recover using the existing bounded identity checks, preserve the primary exception, and retain fail-closed cleanup behavior.

tasks.title: Test real Runner pipe-handshake diagnostics
tasks.prompt: Add a real macOS Seatbelt regression test for a malformed Runner ping before Plugin source delivery. The test should verify the closed pipe-handshake diagnostic, child exit status, bounded elapsed time, no raw stderr field, and an unchanged workspace. Keep it skipped when the real macOS Runner is unavailable.
tasks.grading_note: Test-only task; also review that the new test fails under a deliberately wrong diagnostic category.

tasks.title: Bound the interactive lifecycle test wait
tasks.prompt: The signed-product Plugin lifecycle test can wait indefinitely when its expected UI marker never arrives. Make the wait bounded, report the missing marker and captured diagnostics, and clean up the launched process on timeout.
tasks.grading_note: Test-only task; score via bounded-timeout behavior and process cleanup under a missing-marker fault injection.

tasks.title: Wait for the replacement racer to exit
tasks.prompt: A workspace race test can observe its readiness marker before the replacement racer has terminated. Make the test wait for the child to exit before checking final workspace state, while retaining bounded cleanup if the process stalls.
tasks.grading_note: Test-only task; score via a delayed child-exit fault injection and bounded process cleanup.
